pairSynergies.name: Toxic Bulwark
pairSynergies.description: Fortress units radiate a poison zone: enemies within 2 hexes of a fortress-tagged unit take 2 poison damage per turn. Poisoned enemies cannot attack the source unit.

pairSynergies.name: Stampeding Death
pairSynergies.description: Charge attacks inflict double poison duration. Knockback leaves enemies poisoned in their new position

pairSynergies.name: Poisoned Skirmish
pairSynergies.description: After retreating, the unit leaves a poison trap on the hex it vacated

pairSynergies.name: Venomous Tide
pairSynergies.description: Naval units with poison contaminate coastal hexes for 3 turns. Enemies on contaminated coast hexes take 2 poison damage/turn. Stacks up to 6.

pairSynergies.name: Regenerative Venom
pairSynergies.description: Poisoned enemies cannot heal at all (100% healing reduction). Deals 1 corruption damage to any enemy healer attempting to heal a poisoned target.

pairSynergies.name: Death from the Shadows
pairSynergies.description: Stealth ambushes with poison deal double damage, apply 2 poison stacks instantly, and cost enemies 1 action point to respond

pairSynergies.name: Desert Viper
pairSynergies.description: Camel units with venom apply poison through difficult terrain. Enemies in rough terrain near them take passive poison damage and cannot retreat.

pairSynergies.name: Envenomed Captors
pairSynergies.description: Captured units are poisoned and slowly weakened (3 damage/turn). Slave armies deal +25% damage but heal at half the normal rate. Mercy-killing a captive triggers a 5-stack poison burst in 1-hex radius.

pairSynergies.name: Venomous Smash
pairSynergies.description: Heavy strikes ignore 50% of enemy armor when attacking poisoned targets. Each poison stack adds 25% armor piercing (cap 100%). Full poison = stun.

pairSynergies.name: Concentrated Venom
pairSynergies.description: When a poisoned enemy dies, poison transfers (1 stack) to all adjacent enemies. Cascading kills sweep formations.

pairSynergies.name: Fortress Charge
pairSynergies.description: Charging units adjacent to fortress units get a charge shield: first hit after charging deals 0 damage to the charger. Charging adjacent to a fortress grants +50% damage bonus.

pairSynergies.name: Fortress Skirmish
pairSynergies.description: After hit-and-run retreat, the unit gains a 1-turn 'dug in' bonus: +75% defense until next action. Dug-in counter-attacks deal +50% damage.

pairSynergies.name: Coastal Fortress
pairSynergies.description: Ships bombard land targets within 3 hexes for 50% damage. Allied land units within 2 hexes gain +25% defense.

pairSynergies.name: Citadel
pairSynergies.description: Units with both fortress and healing create a 2-hex healing aura. The unit counts as a city for defense purposes and generates 1 resource per turn.

pairSynergies.name: Hidden Fortress
pairSynergies.description: Stealth fortress units are invisible until they attack or an enemy enters an adjacent hex. First attack from stealth has 2× critical multiplier. Can creep 1 hex while hidden.

pairSynergies.name: Desert Stronghold
pairSynergies.description: Toggle Fort Up (+75% defense, 2-hex aura at +25% ally def) / Decamp (free action). Mobile fortress.

pairSynergies.name: Chained Prisoners
pairSynergies.description: Fortress units guarding slaves gain +50% defense. Counter-attack damage scales with HP lost (25%). Prisoners provide +1 garrison bonus.

pairSynergies.name: Immovable Object
pairSynergies.description: Heavy units in fortress formation reflect 25% damage back to attackers (scaling to 50% at 5+ damage). Adjacent allies are immune to knockback.

pairSynergies.name: Layered Defense
pairSynergies.description: Two adjacent fortress units form an impassable line — enemies cannot move through hexes between them. Ranged attacks crossing the wall halve their range.

pairSynergies.name: Endless Charge
pairSynergies.description: Units with charge can charge, retreat, and charge again in the same turn if they have enough movement points

pairSynergies.name: Tsunami Charge
pairSynergies.description: Naval charge: ships can ram enemy naval units, dealing massive damage with +75% ram bonus and knocking them 1-2 hexes in a random drift direction.

pairSynergies.name: Charging Growth
pairSynergies.description: Charging units adjacent to healing units regenerate after a charge. Successful charges restore 1 movement point.

pairSynergies.name: Stealth Charge
pairSynergies.description: Units with charge can initiate a charge from stealth. The charge deals +50% damage from surprise, but the attacker is revealed until their next turn

pairSynergies.name: Sandstorm Charge
pairSynergies.description: Camel charge: camel units charge through desert terrain dealing AoE damage. Desert charges raise a sandstorm that persists for 2 turns with -25% accuracy.

pairSynergies.name: Press-Ganged Cavalry
pairSynergies.description: Charge attacks have 30% chance to capture enemy units. Captured units are converted to your faction

pairSynergies.name: Unstoppable Momentum
pairSynergies.description: Heavy charges deal massive knockback and stun enemies for 1 turn. Each hex of run-up adds +5% damage (cap +50%).

pairSynergies.name: Stampede Horde
pairSynergies.description: Knockback victims collide with whatever's behind them for +4 damage and 1-turn stun.

pairSynergies.name: Coastal Raid
pairSynergies.description: Attack from water with +25% damage. After attacking, retreat to any water within 2 hexes. Land units cannot pursue.

pairSynergies.name: Healing Retreat
pairSynergies.description: Hit-and-run attacks heal for 100% of damage dealt. Full vampiric lifesteal on retreat.

pairSynergies.name: Shadow Step
pairSynergies.description: Stealth hit-and-run: after attacking from stealth, the unit automatically re-enters stealth at the retreat hex (no cooldown)

pairSynergies.name: Desert Ghost
pairSynergies.description: Retreat through impassable terrain. After passing through impassable, gain +1 movement and re-enter stealth.

pairSynergies.name: Raid Retreat
pairSynergies.description: Hit-and-run attacks have 15% chance to capture wounded enemies (below 50% HP), rising to 40% below 25 HP. Instant retreat with captive.

pairSynergies.name: Heavy Skirmish
pairSynergies.description: Free opportunity strike at full damage when disengaging. Heavy skirmishers hit back on the way out.

pairSynergies.name: Swarm Tactics
pairSynergies.description: When 2+ hitrun units attack the same target in one turn, each subsequent attacker deals +30% damage and ignores defender's defense bonuses.

pairSynergies.name: Tidal Restoration
pairSynergies.description: 2-hex aura heals 4 HP/turn. Cleanses poison, stun, and slow from allies in range each turn.

pairSynergies.name: Silent Landing
pairSynergies.description: Stealth naval units can make amphibious landings without breaking stealth. First attack after landing deals +50% damage. Transported troops gain stealth.

pairSynergies.name: Shoreline Nomads
pairSynergies.description: Full movement on coast, desert, and shallow water. +1 movement bonus in all three terrains.

pairSynergies.name: Naval Slave Raid
pairSynergies.description: Capture from 1 hex away on water. Instant embark captured units. Delivering slaves to a city counts double.

pairSynergies.name: Ironclad Tide
pairSynergies.description: +50% damage on water. Treats coast hexes as water for movement. Ram attacks deal 2 bonus damage.

pairSynergies.name: Armada
pairSynergies.description: Naval units within 2 hexes chain attacks — when one ship attacks, every chained ship contributes +1 damage to that attack (cap +4).

pairSynergies.name: Nature's Veil
pairSynergies.description: Adjacent allies share stealth state. If this unit is stealthed, adjacent allies gain stealth too.

pairSynergies.name: Oasis
pairSynergies.description: Camel units with healing create an 'oasis' effect: the hex they occupy and all adjacent hexes count as neutral terrain for movement purposes. Units at full HP are fully restored at turn end (5-turn cooldown).

pairSynergies.name: Forced Labor
pairSynergies.description: Slaves heal 4 HP/turn. Slaves at full HP produce +1 resource. Requires adjacent healer unit.

pairSynergies.name: Berserker Regen
pairSynergies.description: Heavy units regenerate 30% of damage dealt as HP. Killing an enemy heals 50% of max HP.

pairSynergies.name: Life Bloom
pairSynergies.description: 3-hex aura, +4/+6 HP/turn. Every 3rd turn, instantly heals all allies in radius for +8 HP and grants them +1 movement.

pairSynergies.name: Mirage
pairSynergies.description: Camel stealth units in desert terrain are permanently stealthed. Moving in desert spawns a phantom decoy that lasts 2 turns.

pairSynergies.name: Ambush Captors
pairSynergies.description: Stealth attacks have 40% chance to capture enemies instead of killing them. Silent capture doesn't alert nearby enemies. Gain 1 free movement hex after capture.

pairSynergies.name: Assassin's Blow
pairSynergies.description: Heavy attacks from stealth permanently shred 100% of enemy armor. This is your elite assassin specialist combo

pairSynergies.name: Shadow Network
pairSynergies.description: Stealth units within 3 hexes can swap positions as a free action once per turn. Killing one doesn't reveal others.

pairSynergies.name: Desert Slave Train
pairSynergies.description: Captured units ride as passengers; the raider may release them anywhere along their path as instant slaves at home cities.

pairSynergies.name: Sand Titan
pairSynergies.description: 2-hex sandstorm aura at -20% accuracy. Applies everywhere, not just desert.

pairSynergies.name: Nomad Network
pairSynergies.description: Camel units within 3 hexes share vision. Once per turn, one moves full distance, then any network member makes a free 1-hex move into the vacated hex.

pairSynergies.name: Slave Army
pairSynergies.description: +50% damage, -30% defense. Groups of 3+ ignore ZoC. When one slave dies, adjacent slaves gain +1 movement that turn.

pairSynergies.name: Overseer's Rule
pairSynergies.description: Heavy units commanding slaves increase slave damage by 50%. Slaves adjacent to an overseer gain +1 attack range. Executing an enemy triggers rage in nearby slaves.

pairSynergies.name: Crushing Weight
pairSynergies.description: Knockback persists; victims colliding with other heavy units or terrain edges take +4 damage and 1-turn stun.
